The quiet compounding of small decisions

Body copy set in the default sans that every model reaches for when it is not trying. The headline is set in the display serif it reaches for when it is. That combination is the fingerprint, not either face alone.

More body text so the character share is unambiguous and the dominant body face is measured correctly rather than being swamped by the headline glyph count.

Mono deployed as body text, outside any pre or code element, which is the tasteful-terminal tell. Enough characters here to clear the twenty-five percent share threshold comfortably in this fixture.
